# Oleg Izosimov — Creative Director & Design Group Lead
> Portfolio website of Oleg Izosimov, a creative director and design group lead specializing in brand systems, rebranding, digital campaigns, AI video production, and creative direction. Award-winning creative: Cannes Lions Gold, D&AD, Epica, AD Stars, Red Apple, Eurobest.

## About
Oleg Izosimov is a Russian creative director and design group lead with 15 years in the creative industry. His work spans brand systems, visual identity, digital campaigns, merchandise design, integrated marketing campaigns, AI-assisted production, and vibe-coding websites.

## Awards & Recognition
- Cannes Lions Gold
- D&AD
- AD Stars
- Red Apple
- Epica
- Eurobest
- ADCR jury member
- MAD Stars 2026 judge

## Education & Thought Leadership
- Course author: "Creating an Advertising Campaign: Strategy, Creative, Evaluation" (Netology)
- Podcast host: "Idea Fire" (Идея Огонь), 7 episodes about advertising and creativity

## Key Projects
- **M.Video-Eldorado Brandbook**: first major rebrand in 30 years for a federal electronics retailer; visual system for two brands within one ecosystem.
- **M.Video App Icons**: variable app icon system for seasonal, promo, and event-based scenarios while preserving brand recognition.
- **M.Video Skupidon Campaign**: federal Valentine's Day campaign with Prokhor Shalyapin; key visual and campaign visual language.
- **M.Video POPOLAM Campaign**: federal campaign with a mascot and AI-assisted OLV production.
- **M.Video Merchandise**: concept and design of branded merchandise.
- **Libertex (Forex Club)**: creative direction for brandbook, OLV, educational videos, and digital communications.
- **FC Zenit — This Is All You**: stop-motion campaign from 20,000 photos for Zenit FC x Karan Singh.
- **BMW — Ultimate Giving Pleasure**: promo activation for BMW's 100th anniversary, Cannes Lions Gold 2017.
- **This website with Claude AI + Figma Make**: AI-assisted personal portfolio creation case.
- **AI Video Production**: AI video production from idea and visual approach to final video.
- **The Day Brands Smiled Together**: social campaign where brands added :) to their logos to support children with facial differences.

## Expertise
Brand systems, visual identity, art direction, rebranding, digital campaigns, creative direction, merchandise design, integrated marketing, AI-generated creative, AI video production, motion design, vibe-coding websites.
